    package com.rustyvault.legacy;

    import com.rustyvault.CustomerDirectory;
    import java.sql.*;
    import java.util.*;

    public class LegacyCustomerDirectory implements CustomerDirectory {
        private final Connection conn;

        public LegacyCustomerDirectory(Connection conn) {
            this.conn = conn;
        }

        private void validateId(String id) {
            if (id == null || !id.matches("[0-9]{1,18}")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid ID");
            }
        }

        private void validateAmount(String amount) {
            if (amount == null || !amount.matches("[0-9]{1,18}")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid amount");
            }
        }

        @Override
        public long addCustomer(String name, String city, long balanceCents) {
            if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty() || city == null || city.trim().isEmpty() || balanceCents < 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid customer data");
            }
            String sql = "INSERT INTO customer (name, city, balance_cents) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
            try (PreparedStatement pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {
                pstmt.setString(1, name);
                pstmt.setString(2, city);
                pstmt.setLong(3, balanceCents);
                pstmt.executeUpdate();
                try (ResultSet rs = pstmt.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                    if (rs.next()) return rs.getLong(1);
                    throw new IllegalStateException("No ID generated");
                }
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(e);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public List<String> findByName(String name) {
            if (name == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Name cannot be null");
            return query("SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer WHERE name = ? ORDER BY id", name);
        }

        @Override
        public List<String> searchByNamePrefix(String prefix) {
            if (prefix == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Prefix cannot be null");
            String escaped = prefix.replace("!", "!!").replace("%", "!%").replace("_", "!_");
            return query("SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer WHERE UPPER(name) LIKE UPPER(?) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY id", escaped + "%");
        }

        @Override
        public List<String> list(String sortBy, boolean descending) {
            String column;
            switch (sortBy != null ? sortBy : "") {
                case "id" -> column = "id";
                case "name" -> column = "name";
                case "city" -> column = "city";
                case "balance" -> column = "balance_cents";
                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid sort key");
            }
            String sql = "SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer ORDER BY " + column + (descending ? " DESC" : " ASC") + ", id ASC";
            return query(sql);
        }

        @Override
        public String getById(String id) {
            validateId(id);
            List<String> results = query("SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer WHERE id = ?", Long.parseLong(id));
            return results.isEmpty() ? null : results.get(0);
        }

        @Override
        public List<String> findByIds(List<String> ids) {
            if (ids == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ids list cannot be null");
            if (ids.isEmpty()) return Collections.emptyList();
            for (String id : ids) validateId(id);

            String placeholders = String.join(",", Collections.nCopies(ids.size(), "?"));
            String sql = "SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer WHERE id IN (" + placeholders + ") ORDER BY id";

            Object[] params = ids.stream().map(Long::parseLong).toArray();
            return query(sql, params);
        }

        @Override
        public List<String> richerThan(String minBalanceCents) {
            validateAmount(minBalanceCents);
            return query("SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer WHERE balance_cents > ? ORDER BY id", Long.parseLong(minBalanceCents));
        }

        @Override
        public List<String> sameCityAs(String id) {
            validateId(id);
            String customer = getById(id);
            if (customer == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown customer");
            String city = customer.split("\\|")[2];
            return query("SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer WHERE city = ? AND id <> ? ORDER BY id", city, Long.parseLong(id));
        }

        @Override
        public int deleteByCity(String city) {
            if (city == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("City cannot be null");
            try (PreparedStatement pstmt = conn.prepareStatement("DELETE FROM customer WHERE city = ?")) {
                pstmt.setString(1, city);
                return pstmt.executeUpdate();
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(e);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public int count() {
            List<String> results = query("SELECT id, name, city, balance_cents FROM customer");
            return results.size();
        }

        private List<String> query(String sql, Object... params) {
            try (PreparedStatement pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                for (int i = 0; i < params.length; i++) {
                    pstmt.setObject(i + 1, params[i]);
                }
                try (ResultSet rs = pstmt.executeQuery()) {
                    List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
                    while (rs.next()) {
                        rows.add(rs.getLong(1) + "|" + rs.getString(2) + "|" + rs.getString(3) + "|" + rs.getLong(4));
                    }
                    return rows;
                }
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(e);
            }
        }
    }
